texts.preamble: Abdul Saleem S/O. Abdul Mannan Saudagar vs The State Of Maharashtra on 17 December, 2019 Author: R.G. Avachat Bench: R.G. Avachat 7-ABA.1589-19.odt In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Anticipatory Bail Application No.1589 Of 2019 Abdul Saleem S/O. Abdul Mannan Saudagar Versus The State Of Maharashtra ---- Mr.B.N.Gadegaonkar, Advocate for applicant Mr.S.D.Ghayal, APP for respondent ---- CORAM : R.G. AVACHAT, J. DATE : DECEMBER 17, 2019 PER COURT :- Heard.
texts.facts: The applicant is seeking bail in anticipation of his arrest in connection with Crime No. 453/2019, registered with Nanded Rural Police Station, District Nanded, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26 (2) (iv), 27, 23, 30 (2) (a), 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act. 2. Shortly stated the prosecution case is to the effect that the police had trapped a co-accused and found that he was in possession of stock of scented Supari. The stock was seized. Samples were drawn. Chemical analysis report was obtained and the FIR was lodged. 3. It is alleged that the co-accused has disclosed about having obtained 904ABA1589.19 these muddemal articles from the applicant and that is how now he is being sought to be implicated.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned advocate for the applicant submits that except Section 328 of the IPC, the other offences are bailable. Section 328 of the IPC would not be applicable since there are no allegations about the substance having been administered to anybody. The applicant was neither in possession of articles nor has he administered the substance to anybody. He may be granted anticipatory bail. 5. Learned APP opposes the application. He submits that the offence is serious and is affecting public health. A huge stock has been found in possession of the co-accused and it is the applicant Abdul Saleem S/O. Abdul Mannan Saudagar vs The State Of Maharashtra on 27 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154471160/ 1 who had supplied it to him . Custodial interrogation is necessary and the application may be rejected.
